text.name: Phantump
text.flavor: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.

text.name: Trevenant

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Elder Tree Barrier
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon V, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

text.flavor: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

text.name: Dhelmise

attacks.name: Special Anchor
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

text.flavor: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

text.name: Litwick

attacks.name: Kindling Panic
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

text.flavor: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

text.name: Lampent

attacks.name: Flickering Glow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

text.name: Chandelure

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Mountain Roasting
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck.

text.flavor: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

text.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

text.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

text.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Furtive Drop
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

text.name: Haunter

attacks.name: Cursed Drop
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

text.flavor: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

text.name: Gengar

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Netherworld Gate
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. If you do, put 3 damage counters on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Screaming Circle
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

text.name: Duskull

attacks.name: Future Sight
attacks.text: Look at the top 4 cards of either player's deck and put them back in any order.

text.flavor: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away - or so it's said.

text.name: Dusclops

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

text.name: Dusknoir

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Spectral Breach
abilities.text: All Special Energy attached to Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) provide {Colorless} Energy and have no other effect.

text.flavor: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

text.name: Banette

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Puppet Offering
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand. If you do, put this Pokémon in the Lost Zone. (Discard all attached cards.)

text.flavor: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

text.name: Marshadow

attacks.name: Rapid Hunt
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Rapid Strike cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Shadow Flicker
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Knocked Out during your next turn, take 1 more Prize card.

text.flavor: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.

text.name: Spectrier

attacks.name: Night Footsteps
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and put 2 damage counters on each of them.

attacks.name: Phantom Strike
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Phantom Strike.

text.flavor: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

text.name: Shuppet

attacks.name: Enveloping Shadow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

text.flavor: It feeds on the dark emotions of sadness and hatred, which make it grow steadily stronger.

text.name: Mismagius

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Magical Flick
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

text.name: Drifloon

attacks.name: Balloon Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

text.flavor: It's whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

text.name: Sinistea

attacks.name: Teatime
attacks.text: Each player draws 2 cards.

text.flavor: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

text.name: Drifblim

attacks.name: Curse Spreading
attacks.text: Put 8 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

text.flavor: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

text.name: Polteageist

attacks.name: Teatime
attacks.text: Each player draws 2 cards.

attacks.name: Poltergeist
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there.

text.flavor: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

text.name: Lycanroc
text.flavor: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.

text.name: Mimikyu

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Safeguard
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex and Pokémon V.

attacks.name: Ghost Eye
attacks.text: Put 7 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

text.name: Galarian Runerigus

attacks.name: Spreading Spite
attacks.text: For each damage counter on this Galarian Runerigus, put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Mad Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

text.flavor: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

text.name: Zubat
text.flavor: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

text.name: Greavard

attacks.name: Graveyard Gamboling
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each {Psychic} Pokémon in your discard pile.

text.flavor: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

text.name: Houndstone

attacks.name: Last Respects
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each {Psychic} Pokémon in your discard pile.

text.flavor: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

text.name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Spin Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: United Wings
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack.

text.flavor: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
